item.description:
Thank you for using Levo!

This update brings:

  • Routines: Levo cleans what you choose on a schedule, like app caches every week. Set them up in Settings › Routines.
  • A smarter, more thorough scan: Levo now recognises more kinds of leftover files across more apps and tools, and shows more detail on each one. It also finds apps you haven’t used for a while.
  • Multiple small fixes to improve overall the performance of the app.

Thank you for your feedback. Help improve Levo by reporting bugs and suggesting ideas from Settings › Send feedback.
